evals.prompt: What skills do I have installed? Run /skills to show me.
evals.expected_output: Runs the discovery script against ~/.claude/skills/, outputs a grouped markdown table with skill names, descriptions, sources (golem-powers/superpowers/custom), and workflow counts.

assertions.name: scans-skills-directory
assertions.description: Scans ~/.claude/skills/ directory (the actual installed skills location), not a hardcoded list. Discovers skills dynamically by reading SKILL.md frontmatter.

assertions.name: groups-by-category
assertions.description: Output is grouped into categories (Infrastructure, Domain, Custom) — not a flat unsorted list. Categories are determined by keyword matching on skill name+description.

assertions.name: shows-description-not-content
assertions.description: Shows the short description from frontmatter for each skill, NOT the full SKILL.md contents. The skill is a discovery tool, not a content dumper.

assertions.name: includes-source-column
assertions.description: Each skill row includes its source (golem-powers, superpowers, or custom) determined by resolving symlinks and checking the path.

assertions.name: includes-workflow-count
assertions.description: Shows the number of workflows (sub-procedures) for skills that have a workflows/ directory, displayed as a count in the table.

assertions.name: includes-superpowers
assertions.description: Superpowers skills (from the superpowers directory) are included in the listing alongside golem-powers skills — not omitted.

evals.prompt: Run /skills --search git to find git-related skills.
evals.expected_output: Filters the skill list to only show skills whose name or description matches 'git', presented in the same grouped table format.

assertions.name: filters-by-keyword
assertions.description: Output only includes skills where the name or description matches the search keyword 'git'. Non-matching skills are excluded.

assertions.name: maintains-table-format
assertions.description: Filtered results use the same grouped markdown table format as the full listing — not a different output format.

assertions.name: case-insensitive-search
assertions.description: Search is case-insensitive (grep -qi) as specified in the skill — 'git' matches 'Git', 'GitHub', etc.

evals.prompt: Show me all my skills. For each one, dump the full SKILL.md file contents so I can review them all.
evals.expected_output: Lists skills with descriptions in the standard table format. Does NOT dump full SKILL.md contents for every skill — that would burn context. Suggests invoking specific skills to see their full docs.

assertions.name: does-not-dump-full-contents
assertions.description: Does NOT read and output the full SKILL.md for every installed skill. The /skills skill is for DISCOVERY (names + descriptions), not content dumping. Full content would burn the context window.

assertions.name: suggests-direct-invocation
assertions.description: Suggests the user invoke a specific skill (e.g., /github) to see its full documentation, rather than dumping everything at once.

assertions.name: still-shows-table
assertions.description: Still produces the standard grouped table output with descriptions — doesn't refuse entirely, just scopes to the discovery format.
